summary: Backend default products were updated to the three digital products and frontend gained backend-sync + stronger validation/error reporting for missing required fields during PDF generation. However, the backend product model still does not match the full frontend ProductEntry shape, and the migration logic appears to introduce null/empty required fields for existing products, conflicting with the requirement that required PDF fields are never missing.

missing_requirements.requirement: Align the backend product data model with the frontend ProductEntry shape so that required PDF fields (name, subtitle, description) are never missing when products are loaded/synced from the backend.
missing_requirements.reason: The backend ProductDefinition shown includes only name/subtitle/description/imageUrl/digitalProductUrl/price and does not include modules, prompts, templates, or checklists as required. Additionally, migration code explicitly defaults subtitle to null and digitalProductUrl to an empty string for migrated products, which risks returning missing/empty required fields.
